title: |Du|(A) = 0 when u = 0 a.e. on a measurable A (first conjunct of Simon 2.8, C0)
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ, every measurable set A ⊆ ℝⁿ and every u : ℝⁿ → ℝ with u(x) = 0 for Lebesgue-a.e. x ∈ A (∀ᵐ x, x ∈ A → u x = 0): bvVariationOn u A = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Set (Rn n)) (u : Rn n → ℝ), MeasurableSet A → (∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∈ A → u x = 0) → Chapter02.bvVariationOn u A = 0
